title: fix(browser.start): headful start fails on a headless box under pnpm
description:
## .what

`browser.start --mode HEADFUL` fails on a headless box under pnpm. three defects, one skill file (`dist/domain.roles/playwright/skills/browser.start.sh`):

1. `npx playwright` runs from the caller's cwd. under pnpm the caller's root links no playwright bin, so the chromium lookup gets no output; with `pipefail` the empty grep exits 1 and the start dies at `CHROMIUM_VERSION=$(get_chromium_version_from_playwright)` (line 194).
2. HEADFUL assumes a display. on a box with no `DISPLAY` / `WAYLAND_DISPLAY`, chrome cannot open a window.
3. a headful chrome on a virtual display (no desktop session) aborts with a core dump (Trace/breakpoint trap), for the same sandbox reason the HEADLESS path already handles with `--no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage`.

## .fix

proven via a pnpm patch in ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-bhrain, branch `beav/feat-skeptic-promoted`, file `patches/rhachet-roles-bhrowser@0.1.0.patch`:

- look up the playwright cli from the skill's own package, via node's `require.resolve('playwright/cli.js', { paths: [skillDir] })`, where `skillDir = dirname(readlink -f BASH_SOURCE)`. fall back to `npx playwright`. append `|| true` to the version grep, so an empty match falls through to the extant any-cached-chrome fallback
- `ensure_display_for_headful`: when HEADFUL and no display, start `Xvfb :99` (reuse a live one) and export `DISPLAY=:99`. when Xvfb is absent, exit 2 with a `ConstraintError` that names the fix (`apt-get install -y xvfb`, or `--mode HEADLESS`)
- pass `HEADLESS_FLAGS` (`--no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage`) to the HEADFUL launch too

## .proof

- before: `rhx browser.start --mode HEADFUL --session skeptic` → `MalfunctionError: command failed ... line: 194`
- after all three: `📽️ browser.start ├─ mode: HEADFUL ├─ port: 9804 ├─ wsEndpoint: ws://localhost:9804/...` (2026-11-26)

## .owed

- an integration test for HEADFUL on a box with no display, with Xvfb present and absent
- a test that the start works from a pnpm consumer root that links no playwright bin
